title: Ordered Ramsey and Turán numbers of alternating paths and their variants
summary: An ordered graph is a graph whose vertex set is equipped with a total order. The ordered complete graph $K_N^<$ is the complete graph with vertex set $[N]$ equipped with the natural ordering of the integers. Given an ordered graph $H$, the ordered Ramsey number $R_<(H)$ is the smallest integer $N$ such that every red/blue edge-colouring of $K_N^<$ contains a monochromatic copy of $H$ with vertices appearing in the same relative order as in $H$.
